features.name: FlowFields in Spreadsheets
features.description: Ability to use flow fields directly inside spreadsheets with the advanced spreadsheet and reporting app. Users can pull flow fields from anywhere in the Business Central system and reference them in spreadsheet regions.

features.name: Date Range Regions
features.description: Ability to create date range regions in spreadsheets that automatically calculate date ranges based on formulas like the current year or intervals. Users can specify start dates, intervals, and the number of periods.

features.name: Cell References in Filters
features.description: Ability to insert cell references directly into filter formulas within spreadsheet regions. References use square brackets notation and behave like normal spreadsheet references with relative addressing.
caveats: relative references update as they move down rows

features.name: Slicers in Spreadsheets
features.description: Ability to create slicers in spreadsheets that act as selectors for filtering data. Slicers are defined with a question mark prefix and can filter by date, dimension, field list, or range, allowing users to dynamically filter flowfield calculations.
caveats: slicers must be connected to flowfield regions using absolute references
